name: edlics-plus
description: Web-based file browser and code editor for Linux servers — enhanced fork of Edlics

scripts.build: esbuild bundle/editor.mjs --bundle --format=esm --outfile=public/editor.mjs --target=es2020 --minify && esbuild bundle/terminal.mjs --bundle --format=esm --outfile=public/terminal.mjs --target=es2020 --minify --loader:.css=css && esbuild bundle/charts.mjs --bundle --format=esm --outfile=public/charts.mjs --target=es2020 --minify --loader:.css=css && esbuild bundle/qr.mjs --bundle --format=esm --outfile=public/qr.mjs --target=es2020 --minify && esbuild bundle/ui.mjs --bundle --format=esm --outfile=public/ui.mjs --target=es2020 --minify && node scripts/check-bundles.mjs
